title: Kaizena Flow compared with Squarespace

seo.title: Kaizena Flow vs Squarespace: compared for EU shops
seo.description: How Kaizena Flow compares with Squarespace for EU shops: the EU's rules, more ways to sell, AI, and what needs an add-on, checked on Squarespace's own pages.

heroRest: The legal side of EU selling, more ways to sell and an AI that runs the shop come with Flow. Here is how it compares with Squarespace, line by line.

faq.q: Can I move my Squarespace shop to Flow?
faq.bold: Yes, and we do it for you.
faq.rest: As part of getting you started, we move your shop free of charge. You can also copy pages from your live site and check your old links yourself.

faq.q: Do I need extensions to get what the Flow column shows?
faq.rest: Everything in the Flow column is part of Flow. Owning several stores starts on the Grow plan.
Your store's database and servers are in Dublin, Ireland.

faq.q: Is it safe to let the AI work on its own?
faq.bold: You decide how much it does.
faq.rest: Refunds, emails to your whole list, changes to your staff and your domain always wait for your yes, and every change it makes is in the activity log.
